_: It.24: a HIREABLE follower that plugs into the VANILLA follower system — no custom dialogue or scripts. When you talk to her you get the vanilla 'I need your help. Will you follow me?' topic; hire her and she joins (1-follower limit, 'I need you to do something' / 'It's time for us to part ways' all work), because she leverages Skyrim's DialogueFollower quest. The two requirements that make a generic NPC hireable for FREE: (1) membership in PotentialFollowerFaction (Skyrim.esm:0x05C84D) — the faction the follower dialogue is conditioned on; (2) an Ally Relationship to the player — the free 'Follow me' topic is gated on GetRelationshipRank player >= Ally, so without it she'd only be a paid mercenary at best. She also needs a follower-capable voice (MaleNord/FemaleNord etc. have the lines recorded — using FemaleNord 0x013AE7 here) and the citizenship recipe so she traverses doors/gates when you lead her out. `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, wait ~30-90s, talk to her, pick 'Follow me' — she should become an active follower and trail you (incl. across fast travel, per It.21).

relationships._: Ally relationship to the player. parent = the follower; child = the Player NPC base (Skyrim.esm:0x000014 — NOT PlayerRef 0x000007, which is the placed ACHR; a RELA pointing at an ACHR is a type mismatch that CRASHES on load). This satisfies the DialogueFollower free-follow gate (GetRelationshipRank >= Ally).
